Working Holiday Scheme — application TEST FIXTURE · NOT THE REAL SITE
This is a test fixture for the automated suite. Nothing here is connected to Immigration New Zealand and nothing can be submitted.

Personal details

Page 1 of 6 · text fields, three dropdowns

Are you represented by an immigration adviser?
Do you have a payment card available?

Identification

Page 2 of 6 · the page where a mistake is expensive

Rehearse this page twice as often as the others. The passport number and its expiry are the two fields that cause declined or delayed applications.

Occupation details

Page 3 of 6 · nothing mandatory. Skip with Next.

On the real form this page carries no red asterisks. Do not spend time here.

Health

Page 4 of 6 · all radio groups. Alt+B answers the safe ones.

Are you currently receiving renal dialysis?
Do you have active tuberculosis?
Have you ever had cancer?
Do you have heart disease?
Do you have a mental, physical or intellectual disability?
Are you pregnant?
In the five years prior to this application, have you spent 3 months in any country not considered to be low risk for TB?
Alt+B answers everything above except the TB-risk question and the pregnancy question. Those two are left for you on purpose.

Character

Page 5 of 6 · all radio groups. Alt+B answers them all with No.

Have you ever been convicted of an offence involving imprisonment for 5 years or more?
In the last 10 years, have you been convicted of an offence involving imprisonment for 12 months or more?
Have you ever been deported from any country?
Have you ever been charged with an offence?
Have you ever been excluded from, or refused entry to, any country?
Are you currently under investigation for any offence?

Working Holiday Specific

Page 6 of 6 · mixed answers. Click the three Yes answers first, then Alt+B.

Have you previously been issued a New Zealand working holiday visa?
Do you have sufficient funds (NZD 4,200) to pay your living expenses?
Have you been to New Zealand before?
Do you have sufficient funds to purchase an outward ticket?
Do you meet the specific requirements for this scheme?
Order that works: click Yes on funds (w2), outward ticket (w4) and scheme requirements (w5) first. Then press Alt+B. It skips any group that already has an answer, so the two No answers fill themselves.
